steps.content: The battle ends shortly after, just another accident in WhiteSands—mundane, routine, and overlooked.
DisCity, consumed by the heat of the election, remains oblivious to this "minor incident." No one has noticed this unknown threat that has seized the opportunity to infiltrate.
Before the sands can bury all traces, several figures emerge beside the caravan's wreckage.
Oh... some uninvited guests, I see. Now that they've ventured so deep into our territory, it would be terribly rude of us not to offer them a warm welcome.
She lifts her head, gazing in the direction of DisCity.
